forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,16 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M53FGFKCMXGF6Y35TNVXCKVR
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: 8d80
+title: 'T1 group 1: the 14 shared test helpers whose waits ignore a cancel and have no second event'
+---
+Split from ^nvxckvr (test rule T1). The list of the 14 shared helpers is in the comments of ^nvxckvr.
+
+Rule T1: each wait in a test must also end on the failure event, or the test must fail before it waits. Fixtures close also when the test body throws.
+
+Do: make each shared helper wait end on the first of two events (the expected event, or an existing end event: the call ends, the transport closes, the child process exits, the stream finishes), and end on a cancel. One fix in a helper removes many cases in the tests that use it. A test-only hook in a test helper is permitted. Do not change production code only to add a test hook: bring such a case to the owner. A wait with no existing second event goes on the exception-list card, with file:line and the reason.
+
+Show for at least one helper that a test now fails (not hangs) when the expected event does not come (a one-time mutation that you revert). No .timeLimit, sleep, poll or retry. Do not delete a test. One full run. #elicitation-fixes #t1
\ No newline at end of file
